verdict.rationale: Community comments describe DeepSeek's models as open-source and note the Flash model's weights (~154GB) as 'very accessible for people running large local models,' implying self-hosting is feasible, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation on model licensing, weight downloads, or deployment/self-hosting instructions. missing for 10: official self-hosting guide, license terms, hardware/deployment requirements, hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted deployment.
